PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), and no hardware was attached or run. WHAT IT SERVES: the card's entry symbol homestri_ur5e_rl.envs.base_robot:BaseRobot (re-exported at homestri_ur5e_rl/envs/base_robot/__init__.py:1 from base_robot_env.py:24) through GymnasiumDriver with env_id BaseRobot-v0. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {values: [7 numbers]}} bounded by the -1.0..1.0 action space (base_robot_env.py:65); cap.world.reset.v1 takes {seed, options}; cap.world.seed.v1 takes {seed}. The observation is the 28-element Box of base_robot_env.py:46, carried in full. The device is simulated R0 (world.sim), with no hardware backend. NO DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: decision family-config and helper GymnasiumDriver express the upstream Gymnasium interface. WHY A FAKE, NOT THE UPSTREAM SIMULATOR: the environment itself needs mujoco, gymnasium-robotics and gymnasium (setup.py:7-12), which were not importable and could not be installed under the no-network rule, so backends['fake'] is this package's kinematic stand-in (fake.py); the sim backend (gymnasium.make('BaseRobot-v0')) was not run. The fake implements only reset, step, close and the dt property of the upstream class (gate G7 passed) and its numbers are placeholder test data. FIDELITY: F0 for the checked fake, timestep 80 ms (frame_skip 40 at base_robot_env.py:37 times the 0.002 s timestep at scene.xml:6), determinism seeded, realtime_factor 0, lockstep, full reset, no snapshot/restore; the gaps state that the fake is not MuJoCo, that the controller, gripper and cable are not modelled, that the fake was not compared with upstream, and that nothing was validated against hardware. NOT COVERED: no upstream MuJoCo trajectory was produced or compared; the operational-space controller, Robotiq 2F-85 gripper and flexible cable are not simulated; the upstream rendering and teleoperation path are not exposed. WARNINGS (expected, none failed, no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer/numeric inputs the Gymnasium family derives (ticks, action.values[*], the reset seed and the seed-class seed). TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds six cases (action-space refusal with zero effect, step effect and read agreement, seeded start state, seed class, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); they pass. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used.
